_purpose: Seat queue configuration. Read by scripts/queue/lib.mjs. Every value here is enforced by a refusal in evaluateClaim, not by a sentence in a card.

maintenance_windows.note: Neon scheduled updates. Cost two runs on 2026-09-01: forced a defensive termination of fb490620 at 04:14Z and made a run card unsafe to send. Scale-to-zero is disabled on both computes and does not help; they still restart for updates in this window. Delete this entry only when the window has actually been moved in the Neon console, never because a run got lucky.
Control store, project withered-surf-26870298. Same window. Its suspend_compute events at 22:45:31Z and 00:25:31Z on 2026-08-31 matched the 57P01 deaths exactly.

_boundary_note: A window is [start, end) in UTC. 05:00 is inside, 06:00 is outside. Both edges are asserted in scripts/queue/self-test.mjs.
_pacing_note: next-wake returns 0 when something is claimable, the exact unblock time when it is knowable (window end, token expiry, lease expiry), dep_watch_poll_seconds when the only thing in the way is a dependency ANOTHER SEAT IS CURRENTLY WORKING, and idle_poll_seconds when nobody has started the card in front. Clamped to the ScheduleWakeup range [60,3600].
_token_lifetime_note: The store token expires WITH the claim, not on its own TTL. store_ttl_minutes was removed 2026-09-01: it was 60 against a 90-minute lease, so a lane could hold a card and be mid-work for 30 minutes with no token, while another lane could legitimately take the store. A token that outlives shorter than the work needing it protects nothing.
_store_token_note: Store token removed 2026-09-01. Counties do not conflict with each other.
